vibe: Clean and practical instructions tailored for real-world development.
highlights: This repository authors **Modern Web Guidance** for web platform features (`guides/`), standalone skills (`skills-src/`), and the evaluation harness (`src/`). Because `guide.md` is the **only** file retrieved by external coding agents at runtime (`demo.html`, `expectations.md`, and `targets/` are used within this repo for validation and evaluation), all guidance must be self-contained, deterministic, and command-oriented.
Required Project Skills (Single Source of Truth)
